body:
<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

improvement (high)

## Description

The desktop applications user interface and overall user experience need improvement to make the app more polished, intuitive, and visually appealing.

**Current state:**
The application has basic functionality but the UI/UX could be significantly enhanced for a better user experience.

**Proposed change:**
Review and improve the desktop applications UI components, layout, navigation, visual design, and overall user experience.

**Related issues:**
None identified

> **Reporter Context**
> improve the UI/UX of the desktop application

## Screenshots

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] UI components are visually consistent and follow a cohesive design language (medium)
- [ ] Navigation and workflow are intuitive with clear visual hierarchy (medium)
- [ ] User feedback elements (tooltips, status messages, loading states) are clear and helpful (medium)

## Metadata

**Priority:** medium (medium)
**Effort:** L (medium)
**Suggested model:** GPT-5.5 High (~$3.59/task) · Opus 4.8 Medium (~$3.83/task) _(CursorBench 3.1, 2026-06-12 — advisory)_
**Labels:** gui, ux, enhancement (medium)
title: Improve desktop application UI/UX
